system: Rolling-Memory v0.0.1 (local_plain: on-device 0-LLM, 0-Vector SQLite FTS5 + BM25 + self-information coherence RRF)

protocol.pipeline: Official SGM corpus (11,034 items: 6,742 emails + 3,759 Qwen3-VL-2B image captions + 533 Qwen3-VL-2B video captions) ingested into an isolated local SQLite vault with zero LLM calls and zero vector embeddings. protocol.index_time_note: ~10.3 seconds on Apple Silicon M-series CPU (0 LLM calls, 0 GPU/vector indexing)
